The click selects the coordinate search-result row (the TextView showing the formatted lat/lon) to open its map context menu; on other instances the index differs and the displayed coordinates are rounded/reformatted relative to the raw `binding` value, so the row must be found by text derived from `binding` (with fallbacks), never by index.
steps.snippet:
import re

loc = str(binding["location"]).strip()
nums = re.findall(r'-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?', loc)

pats = []
if len(nums) >= 2:  # coordinates: match OsmAnd's "47.06888° N, 9.50616° E" style
    lat, lon = float(nums[0]), float(nums[1])
    la = f"{abs(lat):.5f}° {'N' if lat >= 0 else 'S'}"
    lo = f"{abs(lon):.5f}° {'E' if lon >= 0 else 'W'}"
    pats += [(la, lo), (f"{abs(lat):.5f}", f"{abs(lon):.5f}")]
pats.append((loc, loc))  # fallback: place-name or raw string match

els = device.elements()
idx = None
for a, b in pats:
    idx = next((i for i, e in enumerate(els)
                if e.get("text") and a in e["text"] and b in e["text"]
                and not e.get("editable")), None)  # skip the search EditText
    if idx is not None:
        break
if idx is None:
    raise LookupError(f"OsmAnd: no search-result row found for location {loc!r}")
device.click(idx)

steps.analysis: This action depends only on OsmAnd being installed and launchable; it can fail on another instance if the installed app's label differs (e.g., "OsmAnd+", "OsmAnd — Maps & GPS") or if the launch is slow, so we open by name, verify the OsmAnd map UI appeared, and fall back to tapping a launcher icon matched fuzzily by name.
steps.snippet:
app = binding.get("app_name", "OsmAnd")
device.open_app(app)
device.settle(3)

# Verify OsmAnd's map screen is in the foreground (signature controls)
if device.find(description="Configure map") is None and \
   device.find(description="Map", clickable=True) is None:
    # Fallback: locate the app icon on launcher/app drawer by fuzzy name
    icon = device.find(description=app, contains=True, clickable=True)
    if icon is None:
        icon = device.find(text=app, contains=True, clickable=True)
    if icon is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"App '{app}' not open and no launcher icon found")
    device.click(icon)
    device.settle(3)
    if device.find(description="Configure map") is None and \
       device.find(description="Map", clickable=True) is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"App '{app}' opened but map screen not detected")
